Res.Caption: Login Name
Res.FullDescription: Username to connect to the FTP server.

Res.Caption: Password
Res.FullDescription: Password to connect to the FTP server.

Res.Caption: Transport Mode
Res.FullDescription: Communication Modes will only be used if the job used in the communication has the same Transport Mode. Communication Modes with a blank Transport Mode will only be used if no other Communication Modes match.

Res.Caption: Recipient Role
Res.FullDescription: Communication Modes will only be used if the Completion Trigger Action used in the communication has the same Recipient Role. Communication Modes with a blank Recipient Role will only be used if no other Communication Modes match.

Res.Caption: Event Code
Res.FullDescription: Communication Modes will only be used if the Event used in the communication has the same Event Code. Communication Modes with a blank Event will only be used if no other Communication Modes match.

Res.Caption: Event Reference Condition Type
Res.FullDescription: Communication Modes will only be used if the Event used in the communication matches the Event Condition Value. Communication Modes with a blank Event Reference Condition Type match everything.

Res.Caption: Event Reference Condition Value
Res.FullDescription: An expression that is compared with the Event Reference field.
